title: Signature Lift Frame

title: Signature Grip Hand
body:

title: Signature Stride Leg

title: Signature Hearing Coil
body:
The Signature Hearing Coil is the Signature edition's cochlear implant: a surgically placed Signature device that stimulates the auditory nerve directly, letting many profoundly deaf recipients perceive sound and, with training, speech.

Signature technology context: the coil mirrors a mature medical technology, fitted by surgical and audiology teams, with outcomes varying by age and training, and it does not restore normal hearing. Limits: surgical risk, cost, and the difficulty of music and noisy rooms.

title: Signature Thought Cap
body:

Signature technology context: the cap mirrors real EEG interfaces, with coarse control, a few commands after training, and sensitivity to noise and fatigue. Limits: signal quality through the skull and the small reliable command count.
